title: Equivariant Cohomological Crepant Resolution Conjecture for ADE-orbifolds
summary: Let G be a non-trivial finite subgroup of SL_2(C) and let p : X \to C^2/G be the minimal resolution. We prove the C^*-equivariant Cohomological Crepant Resolution Conjecture for the ADE orbifold [C^2/G]. More precisely, after specializing the quantum parameters at suitable roots of unity, we prove that the Bryan-Gholampour transformation induces an isomorphism between the C^*-equivariant quantum cohomology of X and the C^*-equivariant Chen-Ruan cohomology of [C^2/G].
